follow-up.name: Automatic follow-up
follow-up.short: Brings back the leads who said they would think about it and went quiet.

order-status.name: Order status
order-status.short: Tells the customer at every stage, without anyone writing the message.

content-engine.name: Content engine

mobilier.name: Custom furniture and kitchens
mobilier.short: Priced from a sketch: fabrics, finishes, lead times.
mobilier.panel: Customers do not think in production terms. The agent asks in the order you would ask yourself — space, material, deadline — and hands sales a request that is ready to price.

dialog.text: What are the dimensions of the wall you are furnishing?
3.2 metres, with a window in the middle.
Fabric or leather? I can show you the price difference on the same configuration.

constructii.name: Renovation and interior design
constructii.short: Quoted by area: stages, crews, schedules.
constructii.panel: A quote starts from the area and from the state the space is in right now. The agent finds out both before a site visit takes up your day.

dialog.text: What is the area, and what state is the space in now?
68 m², a new flat, bare shell.
Full renovation or finishes only? The quote differs by a factor of two.

imobiliare.name: Developers and estate agencies
imobiliare.short: Requirements, budget, a viewing in the calendar.
imobiliare.panel: Budget and timing are settled in the first two questions. The agent asks them, and the estate agent gets a qualified lead with a viewing already proposed.

dialog.text: What budget do you have in mind, and by when?
Up to €90,000, by spring.
I have three options within budget. Does Saturday morning suit you for a viewing?

auto.name: Car dealerships
auto.panel: Configuration, financing and the test drive are three conversations usually held separately. The agent keeps all three inside one.

dialog.text: What do you drive now, and what is missing?
An estate, but I need more space.
Two configurations fit. Shall we book a test drive on Saturday?

energie.name: Solar and HVAC
energie.panel: The payback calculation depends on consumption and on the roof. The agent collects both and sends the quote with the payback period already worked out.

dialog.text: How much do you pay for electricity each month?
Around 2,400 lei.
What kind of roof do you have? The number of panels depends on it.

clinici.name: Dental and aesthetic medicine
clinici.panel: Questions about pain, price and recovery time are hard to ask a person and easy to ask an agent. The patient reaches reception already decided.

dialog.text: What is bothering you, and for how long?
I need an implant, but I am afraid of the pain.
I will explain exactly how it goes and what it costs. Do you prefer mornings?

hero.title: AI agents for businesses where the price is calculated
hero.lead: Rent the agent you need — configured for your niche and your brand, on a monthly subscription. No implementation project, no technical team.

problem.title: The quote is being worked out. Meanwhile the customer is asking somewhere else.

afterHours.title: The question arrives after hours
afterHours.text: Most enquiries land in the evening and at weekends. The answer goes out the next morning — by which time the person has written to three other firms and is comparing.

everyRequestDiffers.title: Every enquiry is different
everyRequestDiffers.text: Dimensions, materials, lead times, budget. Until you have all of them there is nothing to price — and each round of clarification costs another day.

sameAnswers.title: Your salesperson repeats the same ten answers
sameAnswers.text: Their time goes into questions whose answer never changes, instead of the quotes that actually close.

agents.title: Six agents. Rent only the ones you need.
agents.lead: Each agent is a separate product, configured for your niche and your brand. Start with one, add another once the first has shown its result.

custom.title: Need something else?
custom.text: Tell us what the agent should do in your business and we will tell you whether it can be done.

industries.title: Configured for your niche
industries.lead: Not "for any business": different questions, different materials, a different route to the price. Pick your industry and see what the conversation looks like.
industries.otherText: We work in niches that are not on this list too. If the price has to be calculated, the script can be configured.

onboarding.title: From the first conversation to an agent on your site
onboarding.lead: This is not an implementation project. You need no developer, no IT department and no new website — the agent sits on top of what you already have.

talk.title: The conversation
talk.text: What you sell, how the price is worked out at your company, and what people ask you most often. Nothing to prepare in advance.

materials.title: The materials
materials.text: Website, product sheets, price list, terms. In whatever form they exist — Excel, PDF, Word, photos. Putting them in order is our job.
materials.time: As long as an email takes

config.title: The configuration
config.text: The script for your niche, your pricing rules, your brand on the quote. You see the agent before your customers do and correct anything that does not sound like you.

embed.title: One line of code
embed.text: A script on your site. The widget runs isolated from the page styles, so it breaks nothing you already have. If there is nobody to do it, we do it.

onboarding.total: Usually under two hours of your time in total. The rest is on us — including the unpleasant part, where the price list has to be read line by line.

pricing.setupNote: Initial setup — {fee}, once: the conversation, reading your price list line by line, the script for your niche and your brand on the quote. Without it the agent would answer from general copy rather than from your prices.

features.ownRules: Your own pricing rules, however complicated

portal.title: One place where you see everything the agent did
portal.lead: The agent works on your site. What comes out of that work — requests, quotes, numbers — waits for you in the portal, not scattered across an inbox.
portal.panelText: Every client has their own portal with their own data. You do not ask us for a report and wait until we send it — you log in and look.

capabilities.leads: Leads — every request, with everything the customer said
capabilities.offers: Quotes — every PDF issued, with its number and date
capabilities.stats: Statistics — where people stop and what they ask
capabilities.agents: Agents — switch on, switch off, correct the answers

portal.cta: See the portal in a demo

faq.title: What people ask before they start
faq.lead: If your question is not here,

timeline.q: How long until the agent is on my site?
timeline.a: From your side — one conversation and the materials you already have. The timeline depends on the shape your price list is in: a spreadsheet is one thing, a scanned catalogue is another. We give you a concrete date after the first conversation, not before.

unknown.q: What does the agent do when it does not know the answer?
unknown.a: It does not invent one. It answers from your materials, and when the answer is not there it says it will check and captures the request, with everything discussed up to that point. Your salesperson gets the conversation, not an "interested lead".

data.q: Where does my customers' data go?
data.a: It stays yours and is isolated from every other client on the platform — not by a promise, but by the way the database is built. One account cannot reach another account's data.

site.q: Do I have to change my website?
site.a: No. One script is added, and that is all. The widget runs isolated from the page styles, so it cannot break what you have — not the fonts, not the layout. If there is nobody to add it, we do it.

language.q: What language does the agent speak?
language.a: Whichever one it is written to in. Romanian and Russian are configured from the start, English as well. We match the tone to how you speak to your customers, not to a manual.

priceChange.q: What happens when I change my prices?
priceChange.a: You send us the new list. The agent prices by rules rather than by figures written by hand into answers, so a price change does not require reconfiguring from scratch.

cancel.a: Yes, it is monthly. What happens to your data and to quotes already issued after you stop is written in the contract, and you read it before signing, not after.

reviews.q: Why are there no reviews or client logos on this site?
reviews.a: Because we do not have enough of them yet to mean anything. The platform is being run in on a real client in made-to-order furniture, whom we do not name until they agree. We would rather show no logos than logos that do not tell the truth.

finalCta.title: See the agent on your own products, not on a generic demo
finalCta.lead: In the demo we take a few products from your catalogue and show you exactly what the agent would answer a real customer.
finalCta.note: No hour-long presentation. Thirty minutes and the agent on screen.

chatbot.conversationNote: An example for made-to-order furniture. The prices in the answer come from the client's list, not from us.

dialog.text: Hello. How much would a kitchen along a 3.2 metre wall cost?
That depends first of all on the fronts and the worktop. Do you have a preference — painted MDF, veneer or foil?
Painted MDF. And a stone worktop.
For 3.2 m with painted MDF and a quartz worktop, the range in our list is 38,000 – 46,000 lei, depending on the hardware and the appliances.
And how long does it take?
Production takes around 30 working days from the moment the design is confirmed. If you leave me an email I will send the exact quote today — do you have a photo or a drawing of the space?

The questions you already get most often

Answers things that have nothing to do with your business

chatbot.platformsTitle: It works on the site you already have
chatbot.platformsLead: It is a script. If you can add a script to the page — directly, through a plugin or through Google Tag Manager — the agent works. If there is nobody to do it, we do it.
chatbot.faqTitle: What people ask about the chatbot

faq.q: How long until it is on my site?
faq.a: From your side — one conversation and the materials you already have. The timeline depends on the shape your price list is in: a spreadsheet is one thing, a scanned catalogue is another. We give you a concrete date after the first conversation.

faq.q: What if it answers something wrong?
faq.a: You see every conversation in the portal. When something sounds wrong, the source it answered from gets corrected — and the correction takes effect immediately, not in the next release. Mistakes in the first week are normal, which is exactly why you read the conversations.

faq.q: Can it take orders and payments?
faq.a: It can collect the complete request and hand it to your salesperson. Order confirmation and payment stay with you — we do not want an agent taking money on your behalf.

faq.q: What happens to my customers' data?
faq.a: It stays yours and is isolated from every other client on the platform — not by a promise, but by the way the database is built.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes, and it is designed for the small screen first: that is where most questions come from. The window does not cover the page and closes with one gesture.

chatbot.closingTitle: See the chatbot answering about your own products
chatbot.closingLead: In the demo we take a few products from your catalogue and show you exactly what it would answer a real customer.
